clues.line: Your signed letter, lying in plain sight. You were in this room tonight.
The butler's glove beside the desk. He dropped it while searching.
A note with your name on it, right here. How careless.
An open window and muddy prints pointing inward: someone climbed in from the garden.
Prints that come in from the garden... through a window nobody opened?
Arthur's scarf, beside the empty jewellery box.

alibiOptions: I was out of the house all evening.
I was in the hallway at 20:55, then went on to the guest room.
I was in the library at 21:00.

clues.line: The clock stopped at nine. That is when it happened.
A torn contract with your signature. There is your motive.
The secretary's key on the library desk. He was in this room.
Out all evening? The guard saw you in the hallway at 20:55.
Your account fits the guard's statement.
In the library at nine, by your own account: the very moment the clock stopped.

alibiOptions: I was in the study at 21:10.
I left the study before 21:00 and was in the living room during the theft.
I left the house at 20:50 with the secretary.

clues.line: The hall clock stopped at 21:10, and Arthur arrived at nine. He was in the house.
The secretary left at 20:50. He was long gone by then.
The stolen document... with your fingerprint on it!
Arthur's briefcase beside the desk the document was taken from.
And the butler's scarf by the desk too? Two trails at once. Someone has been arranging this.
An open window, yet no marks of anyone climbing in.
In the study at 21:10? Then you were there when the document vanished.
Your account does not clash with the times.
You left with the secretary at 20:50? The guard saw him leave alone.
